title: I made a SHMUP w/ Godot and Claude Code
author: AdamBlue
selftext: I spent the weekend using Claude Code with Godot - including ChatGPT, Pixel Lab, and Suno for all asset creating. I started by uploading a design document I made in 2014, and asked to make a milestone based project plan. After being happy with the mechanics, I just focused on the start and first level. It was really a matter of simple prompts like "Make other player ships show up at the beginning as a cutscene, and then have them fly off before the level starts". Really just conversational. It has a really cool upgrade/parry system that I've been focusing on for this to be a unique shmup experience.
